'''R5-B8''' was an [[R5-series astromech droid|R5 unit]] who was present on [[Sel Zonn Station]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
R5-B8 worked for the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Switch]], in [[Deep Storage Bay V14]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. He was friends with Switch and the information broker considered the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] to be his closest companion. He was red and blue in color.
